stages.discovery: Clawed prints crisscross the muddy trail, and drops of blood lead off into the underbrush toward a stand of trees.

choices.label: Examine the Tracks First
choices.description: A closer look before moving on - Survival check

check.success_outcome: The prints are too large for any rat you know - more paw than foot, walking upright. Whatever made them isn't finished.
check.failure_outcome: The tracks are too smeared with blood and mud to read clearly - only that something came through here recently, and in a hurry.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - leave it be

stages.ignore: You leave the tracks to whatever made them and continue down the road.

stages.discovery: Beyond the trees, you hear frantic, ragged breathing and the scrape of claws on stone - something is circling, and something else is still alive.

choices.label: Circle First
choices.description: Get a look at what you're walking into - Perception check

check.success_outcome: Through the brush you count several hunched, rat-like shapes pacing around a fallen courier and a shattered strongbox, their fur bristling in the moonlight.
check.failure_outcome: The moonlight and brush make it hard to count shapes moving out there - only that something's circling, and something else has already stopped fighting back.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - turn back now

stages.ignore: You back away from the trees and leave whatever's hunting there to finish its work.

stages.discovery: Feral, man-shaped shadows circle a wounded courier sprawled beside a shattered strongbox.
stages.sneak_success: You keep to the shadows and count the wererats circling the courier before they ever catch your scent.
stages.sneak_fail: A wererat's nose twitches toward you before you're close enough to see clearly. In a blink, every yellow eye is on you.
stages.ignore: You back away from the strongbox and the shadows around it. Behind you, the courier's cries don't last long.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

victim_data.dialogue: They came out of nowhere - please, help me hold them off!
thanks: You saved my hide and the guild's shipment both. I won't forget this.
after: My employer will hear about this. You've more than earned their thanks.

aftermath.discovery: The wererats lie dead. The courier is bleeding but alive, guarding the broken strongbox like it still matters.

choices.label: Escort the Courier to Town
choices.description: See them and the shipment safely to Northfield
choices.outcome: You help the courier gather what's left of the shipment and walk them back to Northfield. The Merchant Guilds are quick to hear of it, and quicker to reward it.

choices.label: Help Recover the Shipment
choices.description: Gather what spilled from the strongbox first
choices.outcome: You help scoop the scattered coin and papers back into the broken strongbox. The courier thanks you and presses on alone once they've caught their breath.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: ESC also cancels - the shipment isn't your problem
choices.outcome: You leave the courier to gather the strongbox's contents alone and move on.
